purposeSummary: Everything between 'project row created' and 'inspector can start drawing': PDF upload, TOC/sheet-index parsing, calibration hydration, pay-item import, specs upload, and folder seeding. No field-capture work can begin until this stream completes.

outputs: PDF stored at {userId}/{uuid}.pdf in project-pdfs bucket
intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: Name and PDF required; toast on missing fields; on success user lands at /project/:id with PDF rendered.

outputs: Supabase storage path {userId}/{uuid}.pdf in project-pdfs bucket
intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: Upload must complete before project row is inserted; signed URL must be derivable from storage path.
On offline, IDB cache (safePut/safeGet) is used with toast 'Viewing cached project data.'. State hydrated via useProject.initProject().
risks: IDB cache staleness not surfaced to user beyond toast

outputs: TocEntry[] persisted to public.projects.toc JSONB via useProject.updateToc
intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: Drag-selecting the INDEX OF SHEETS region must produce ≥1 TocEntry per visible row. Toast 'No entries found' on empty parse.
risks: Hardcoded 5px Y-grouping tolerance breaks dense or rotated text layouts
console.log debug noise in production (pdf-utils.ts extractTextFromRegion)
crossStreamHandoffs: feeds: S04 (section-keyed color assignment for pay items)

intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: Must parse multi-column TOC layouts; must handle sheet numbers like '1-1', 'COVER'.
risks: No parse-quality indicator returned to UI

intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: TOC must be present in useProject state after hard reload of /project/:id.

outputs: PayItem[] with {itemCode, name, unit, unitPrice, contractQty, color}
intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: Populates pay-item list; deduplicates against existing items; toasts count or 'All items already imported'.
risks: Magic number +4 pages: no UI indication of scan extent or stop point
Heuristic regex fails on non-standard table layouts (merged cells, scanned pages)

intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: Must extract itemCode, name, unit, unitPrice columns from standard NJTA/NJDOT schedule-of-values tables.
risks: Silently returns [] on rotated text or scanned pages

outputs: PayItem appended to project state and persisted
intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: Non-drawable items must show 'quantity must be entered manually' notice. Save updates project state immediately.

outputs: PATCH to public.projects (pay_items JSONB or related column)
intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: Pay items must be present in sidebar after hard reload.

intentLeaves.intent: Standard Specs PDF upload and indexing
outputs: specs PDF stored at {projectId}/specs.pdf in specs-pdfs bucket
intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: Upload toasts 'Loading Standard Specs…'; on success toasts 'Specs Loaded'. specs_storage_path persisted.
risks: upsert: true at fixed path {projectId}/specs.pdf — concurrent uploads silently overwrite previous specs

outputs: calibration scale applied to useProject state; subsequent measurements use correct px-to-unit ratio
intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: On /project/:id load, calibration must be fetched and applied before any measurement annotation is created.

outputs: section-keyed colors assigned to pay items
intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: Each TocEntry must be navigable (clicking jumps to startPage). Sections list must update immediately after TOC import without reload.
risks: No persistence model for section colors beyond in-memory assignment; color conflicts on large TOCs not handled

intentLeaves.intent: initProject seam — single hydration entry point
outputs: useProject state fully populated for field-capture consumption
intentLeaves.gatingCriteria: All onboarding sub-streams (TOC, pay items, calibration, specs path) must be complete before this call is meaningful.
risks: Partial hydration (e.g. specs not yet uploaded) is not distinguished from fully onboarded state

openRisks.description: extractPayItemsFromPage and extractTextFromRegion are pure heuristics; scanned or rotated PDFs silently produce zero entries with no user feedback.
console.log debug noise from TOC parsing in production; no structured logging or parse-quality telemetry.
+4 page pay-item scan limit is a magic number; UI gives no indication of where scan stopped or how many pages were examined.
specs_storage_path uses upsert at fixed path — concurrent or repeat uploads silently overwrite without versioning.

criticalSeams.description: Single call that assembles all onboarding outputs into the state consumed by field-capture. Must receive all sub-stream outputs before field work begins.
First population of PayItem[]. Pay-item-catalog stream (S05) treats this as the source of truth for initial item lifecycle.
